headline: Kim Jong-un Crosses New Yalu River Bridge Into China
deck: South Korea’s Unification Ministry said Kim entered Dandong over the bridge, opened Oct. 15 after a long delay.
body: Kim Jong-un arrived in Dandong, Liaoning Province, on Saturday via the New Yalu River Bridge, South Korea’s Unification Ministry said. [E1][E2]
The four-lane bridge links Dandong with Sinuiju in North Korea’s North Pyongan Province and spans 3.03 kilometers. [E3][E4]
The bridge officially opened on Oct. 15. [E5][E6]
Construction was completed in 2014, but the opening was delayed for more than a decade because infrastructure on the North Korean side was unfinished. [E7]
